verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins (docs-5), and the desktop app docs say everything in your vaults is accessible offline with no setup (docs-9), so offline viewing of codes is plausibly covered. The evidence never shows that codes can be used without a Proton account, and community notes tie integrated TOTP to paid Pass Plus/Unlimited plans (comm-2). That leaves the 'no vendor account required' half of the story undelivered. Missing for 10: evidence of account-free or local-only use, explicit confirmation that TOTP generation itself works offline across all clients, and independent hands-on offline testing.
